title: Coefficient4 logarithmic-divisor family with joint exact initial allocation and explicit error margin

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Let L=ceil_logN,z=ceil_logL,Dint=max(2,z),C=2^20,P2 upwardpower2. Paid gamma S<=2^L has H=2floor_logS+1;bits3j,3j+1,3j+2 ofS-1 decode U-1,V-1,T-1. Set h=P2(UL\u00b2),e=P2(VL\u00b2z),ell=P2(16ze). Enumerate a=2^j<=h,B=ceil(L/j)..ceil(5L/j),initial E0=ceil_sqrtL+ceil(L/125)..L. Each has ep=100haell+e+2,q=(2h(a-1)+Cez\u00b2)ell,d=max(q,(2ha+10)ell,2P2(8(ell+ep+L+10))),Y=100Bhd+Cez\u00b2d,k=hY+100Bhaell+10d+Cez\u00b2ell. Skipceil_logk>floor_logN. Initial AffineSeedPlan(N,k,P2(Y),E0,D10,canonicalTrue) must be valid with actual d0<=5L,ceil(d0/j)<=B,125E0-d0>=125ceil_sqrtL. Select lexmin(k,j,B,E0),first feasible E0 per(a,B);no field bound until selected. Take explicit Y-bit initial prefix. All selection uses N,S only. Ordered padded base-a index words;four internal B2.1maps Dint,K=Cez\u00b2M,atmost2 eventualcalls,seedell. C6 raises fielddegree to maxs_star,rechecks own metadata/seed/advice;ONE paid C5 package t_star-a(t_star),t_star=Dint*s_star. C5/C3 compile once;bad data ring/zero maps. Good primitive tuple works universally. ShortE1 directB2.3,no data. Initial/B5canonical searches C1 polynomial under5L cap. B5 uses supplied A2sampler,A1D4helper,weakhash,exactboundedfreshseedrounds;prefixdegree1000w/output250w. CompleteG nonlinear. Layoutdelta1/125,m=floor(r/125),b=floor(Tw/(30*125\u00b2)),u=2b+2w+10,w=ceil_logr;scaleT\u00b2. One fixed goodS0 is paid. Allheaders/data handled by one polynomial algorithm;NP emptywitness. Exact margin gives badgroup product<=2^(-sqrtL+O_S0(z));prefixP=O_S0(L\u00b2z\u00b2)=o(k),includingALLheader/data bits.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"This fixed total language is in P and NP with empty witnesses on every input. There exist absolute B>0,N0 such that for every actual integer N>=N0, unconditionally in pinned full B2, C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-B*(log2 N)^9*(log2(log2 N))^5/log2(log2(log2 N)). For the SAME family and every fixed epsilon>0, eventually C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-(log2 N)^9*(log2(log2 N))^(5+epsilon), hence also4*N-(log2 N)^(9+epsilon) and4*N-N^epsilon. One fixed gamma header S0 gives hardness. Exact loss is4*P(N,S0)+8*k(N,S0), including the ENTIRE header and all data; P=O_S0(L^2*(ceil(log2 L))^2)=o(k), including the shared growing-dimension package serving all four maps. The supplied finite4n-8d theorem covers all16 B2 tables, constants and sharing. The robust moment proof needs O(r^2) ROW independence and O(r^2*u) log-error. Layout loses only a factor2^O_S0(log r), preserving actual bad-coordinate accounting. No numerical B, efficient search for S0 or unpaid weak-design construction is assumed. C22 jointly minimizes exact(k,log2a,B,E0) over its finite scalar feasible set using initialD10 and explicit125E0-d0>=125ceil_sqrtL guard. Supplied feasibility/resource/error proof gives all-length closure without imposing a fixed precision denominator;guards deriveE0>=L/125. At ONE fixed good packed code,the limsup of complete certified loss divided by the preceding optimized-alphabet allocation's loss is at most337/357<1. Fields,prefixes,layouts/functions may change. Full divisor theorem and native4,1 remain.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
